description: Four linear voltage-controlled amplifiers, cascaded left to right so that any output left unpatched is added into the next channel's output; the fourth amplifier is controlled only by its CV input

params.text: Sets the starting gain of that amplifier, which is added to the voltage at its control input; the maximum bias is 5V, which is a gain of 1
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at that channel's CV input before it sets the gain

inputs.text: The signal into that amplifier, DC-coupled so audio, control voltage and triggers all pass
Sets the gain of that amplifier, added to its gain knob; 5V opens the amplifier fully and higher voltages are clipped
Sets the gain of the fourth amplifier; with nothing patched here it is held at an internal 5V, which leaves that amplifier fully open

outputs.text: The output of that amplifier; with no cable patched here its signal is added into the next channel's output instead
The output of the fourth amplifier, carrying the sum of it and every earlier channel whose own output is unpatched

notes: a channel whose own output is left unpatched is added into the next channel's output instead, so the last patched output down the row carries the sum of everything above it.
